paper_title: Discovering QCD-Coupled Axion Dark Matter with Polarization Haloscopes
notes: Projection paper for a 'polarization haloscope' probing the QCD axion-gluon coupling. The main sensitivity figure (Fig. 2) is plotted as 1/f_a (GeV^-1) vs m_a (eV), spanning roughly ma = 1e-7 to 1e-4 eV and 1/fa = 1e-14 to 1e-5 GeV^-1. This is the axion-gluon (theta) coupling, which manifests as an oscillating EDM (dn = 2.4e-3 e fm * theta_a). The pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is broadly consistent (nuclear/EDM effect), though the plotted variable is 1/f_a rather than d_n directly. No numerical table of the projected curve is provided; only a figure, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs could be extracted. Values are projections (SNR>=2), not measured limits.
